subject.title: iOS app: node requests re-approval on every reconnect (token persistence bug)

question: Should this issue stay open until current-main iOS LAN/VPN reconnect proof shows no repeated node reapproval, or is the merged private-LAN bootstrap persistence fix enough to close it?
rationale: Source and tests prove the LAN bootstrap token-loss class is fixed on main, but the reported central symptom is repeated node reapproval and current gateway code still has an independent reapproval path for capability, command, or permission drift.

options.title: Keep open for live iOS reconnect proof
options.body: Require a real iPhone current-main/TestFlight LAN or VPN reconnect run that approves once, restarts the app several times, and shows no new pending node reapproval before closing.

options.title: Close as covered by bootstrap persistence
options.body: Accept PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98066 as sufficient for this report despite the remaining unproven node reapproval path.

recommendation.title: Keep open for live iOS reconnect proof
recommendation.body: Require a real iPhone current-main/TestFlight LAN or VPN reconnect run that approves once, restarts the app several times, and shows no new pending node reapproval before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the landed iOS LAN bootstrap repair and proof discussion for the partial fix.
